fullPassage:
Choosing a career is one of the biggest life decisions young people face. Mapping out the right career path can be demanding. While some teenagers have a clear vision of their career goals, others struggle to define them. This is where role models can be useful. They help young people start to plan their careers by providing them with guidance and the sense of purpose they need to succeed. We asked our teenage readers about their role models and the qualities they admire most in them. After you read each student's story, you will get a better idea of the profound impact role models can have when it comes to shaping career goals.

My role model is Jacques Cousteau, a famous ocean explorer. As a young boy, Cousteau was involved in a serious car accident, and doctors told him he might never use his arms again. However, he refused to give up. Following his doctors' advice, he started swimming as a way to strengthen his arms. It was during this recovery that he became intrigued by the underwater world. At the time, diving equipment was insufficient for deep exploration. This challenge inspired Cousteau to co-invent the Aqua-Lung, a device that allowed divers to breathe underwater for extended periods. He also produced a famous documentary that opened people's eyes to the beauty and fragility of ocean life. Cousteau became a leading figure in marine conservation. What I admire most about him is his curiosity and passion for pushing beyond boundaries.

My role model is Joan Beauchamp Procter, a pioneering British zoologist who devoted her life to the study of reptiles. From a young age, Procter showed a deep devotion to animals, especially reptiles. She was so immersed in her studies that she often brought her pet reptiles to school. Despite suffering from serious health problems throughout her life, she never let them hold her back. Procter gained extensive knowledge of reptiles, and at the age of just sixteen, she began exchanging letters with George Albert Boulenger, one of the most respected zoologists of that era. Impressed by her knowledge, Boulenger encouraged her to pursue a career in zoology. She went on to become the curator of the Reptile House at the London Zoo, where she transformed it into a world-class facility by incorporating technology and innovative design.

My role model is Kim Sang-jin, a Korean animator who worked at Disney. From a young age, Kim was enthusiastic about drawing and dreamed of becoming an animator. However, he was diagnosed with color vision deficiency, which disrupted his plans. Many people tried to discourage him from pursuing art, but he refused to give up. Instead, he earned an economics degree while continuing to develop his drawing skills. He built an impressive portfolio and eventually landed a position at Walt Disney Studios. What I admire most about Kim is his persistence and positive attitude. He never let obstacles define his future.

These stories show us the importance of having role models. Whether it is Cousteau's curiosity, Procter's devotion, or Kim's persistence, each of them demonstrates qualities that can inspire us. Their commitment and optimism teach us that career exploration is a journey, not a destination. Role models remind us that with hard work and dedication, we can achieve our goals.

questions.passage: Choosing a career is one of the biggest life decisions young people face. Mapping out the right career path can be (A)[demanding / effortless]. While some teenagers have a clear vision of their career goals, others struggle to define them. This is where role models can be useful. They help young people start to plan their careers by providing them with (B)[guidance / confusion] and the sense of purpose they need to succeed. We asked our teenage readers about their role models and the qualities they admire most in them. After you read each student's story, you will get a better idea of the (C)[profound / trivial] impact role models can have when it comes to shaping career goals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ demanding — guidance — profound: 원문 일치
❌ ② effortless(수월한): demanding의 반의어
❌ ③ confusion(혼란): guidance의 반의어
❌ ① trivial(사소한): profound의 반의어
det.tip: demanding(힘든) ↔ effortless(수월한), guidance(지침) ↔ confusion(혼란), profound(깊은) ↔ trivial(사소한)

det.tip: intrigued(흥미를 느낀) ↔ bored(지루한), insufficient(불충분한) ↔ adequate(충분한), extended(연장된) ↔ limited(제한된)

det.analysis:
❌ ① hesitate(망설이다) → succeed(성공하다): 롤모델은 젊은이들이 성공(succeed)하는 데 필요한 목적의식을 제공하는 것이지 망설이게(hesitate) 하는 것이 아님 ←정답

questions.passage:

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 figure와 같은 의미로 사용된 것은?
ch: Can you figure out this problem?
The figure on the graph shows a decline.
He is a key figure in the company.

det.korean: He is a key figure in the company.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ figure = 인물: He is a key figure(핵심 인물)과 본문의 a leading figure(선도적 인물)이 같은 의미 ←정답
❌ ① figure = 체형: slim figure(날씬한 체형)
❌ ② figure out = 알아내다: 동사구로 다른 의미
❌ ③ figure = 수치/도표: figure on the graph(그래프의 수치)
det.tip: figure의 다의어: ① 인물(person) ② 체형(body shape) ③ 수치/도표(number/chart) ④ figure out(알아내다, 동사구)

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 landed와 같은 의미로 사용된 것은?
ch: After years of effort, she finally landed her dream job.
The ball landed in the neighbor's yard.
The airplane landed safely at the airport.
A butterfly landed on the flower.

det.korean: After years of effort, she finally landed her dream job.
det.analysis:
✅ ① landed her dream job = 일자리를 얻다: 본문의 landed a position과 같은 의미 ←정답
❌ ② landed in the yard = 떨어지다
❌ ③ landed at the airport = 착륙하다
❌ ④ landed on the flower = (가볍게) 내려앉다
det.tip: land의 다의어: ① 착륙하다 ② 내려앉다 ③ (일자리/기회를) 얻다 ④ 떨어지다. 본문에서는 ③의 의미.

questions.passage: Impressed by her knowledge, Boulenger encouraged her to pursue a career in zoology. She went on to become the curator of the Reptile House at the London Zoo, where she transformed it into a world-class facility by _____(incorporate) technology and innovative design. My role model is Kim Sang-jin, a Korean animator who worked at Disney.
questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 주어진 단어의 알맞은 형태를 **영어**로 영어로 (1단어) 쓰시오.

She transformed it into a world-class facility by __________ technology and innovative design. [incorporate]

det.korean: 기술과 혁신적 설계를 도입하여(incorporating) 세계적 수준의 시설로 탈바꿈시켰다.
det.analysis: ✅ incorporating: incorporate(통합하다/도입하다)의 동명사. 전치사 by 뒤이므로 동명사 형태.
det.tip: incorporate → incorporating: 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 온다. by + 동명사: ~함으로써.

Whether it is Cousteau's __________, Procter's devotion, or Kim's persistence, each of them demonstrates qualities that can inspire us. Their commitment and optimism teach us that career exploration is a journey, not a destination. Role models remind us that with hard work and dedication, we can achieve our goals.

Whether it is Cousteau's __________, Procter's devotion, or Kim's persistence [curious]

det.korean: 쿠스토의 호기심(curiosity), Procter의 헌신, Kim의 끈기 중 어느 것이든.

det.tip: curious(형용사) → curiosity(명사): 소유격 뒤에 명사가 필요. Cousteau's curiosity, Procter's devotion, Kim's persistence — 같은 구조의 병렬.

det.korean: 근면과 헌신(dedication)으로 우리는 목표를 달성할 수 있다.

det.tip: dedication = devotion = commitment: 헌신, 전념. dedicate(동사) → dedication(명사).
